import torch
from examples.image_core import load_snapshot, pixels_to_tensor, make_model
torch.manual_seed(42)
images, labels, train, _ = load_snapshot()
batch_x = pixels_to_tensor(images[train[:64]])
batch_y = torch.tensor(labels[train[:64]], dtype=torch.long)
model = make_model()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.01)
model.train()
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
loss = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(batch_x), batch_y)
loss.backward()
optimizer.step()
print(tuple(batch_x.shape), len(batch_y), bool(torch.isfinite(loss)))
